limitations.note: The counter fix was correct, but the new square-wave branch forces the output low on entry instead of holding the previous waveform value until the counter reaches 9.
The triangle rewrite makes the first sample after reset 1 instead of the original 5-bit wrap to 31 and changes direction handling when entering triangle mode.
The test expected the rewritten triangle startup and the forced-low square-mode entry, so it passed despite both cycle-by-cycle regressions.
